Copied unmodified from the reference engine (apps/geometry-service/tests/fixtures/fonts/
at brooklineind-website fa18e7fa) for the ported text_* fixture recipes in
tests/fixtures/builders/. The account below is the reference's, verbatim.

Bundled test fonts — apps/geometry-service/tests/fixtures/fonts/
================================================================

These font files exist for ONE reason: the real-font marking fixtures
(`text_*` in tests/fixtures/fixture_generator.cpp) initialise
Font_BRepFont from a FILE PATH in this directory, never from a family
name. A fixture whose geometry depends on which fonts happen to be
installed on the host is not reproducible between this machine, CI and
the Fly.io image, and a non-reproducible fixture is worse than no
fixture. Nothing outside the fixture generator reads these files; they
are not shipped to a client and not served by the web app.

--------------------------------------------------------------------
Liberation fonts 2.1.5
    LiberationSans-Regular.ttf
    LiberationSans-Bold.ttf
    LiberationSerif-Regular.ttf
    LiberationMono-Regular.ttf

  Source:  https://github.com/liberationfonts/liberation-fonts
           release liberation-fonts-ttf-2.1.5.tar.gz
  Licence: SIL Open Font License, Version 1.1
           -> LICENSE-Liberation-OFL-1.1.txt (verbatim from the release)
           -> AUTHORS-Liberation.txt (verbatim from the release)
  Copyright: Digitized data (c) 2010 Google Corporation with Reserved
             Font Names Arimo, Tinos and Cousine;
             (c) 2012 Red Hat, Inc. with Reserved Font Name Liberation.

  OFL 1.1 permits redistribution, bundled or sold with other software,
  in a closed-source product, provided the licence travels with the
  font files and the Reserved Font Names are not used for modified
  versions. These files are unmodified, so both conditions hold.

--------------------------------------------------------------------
DejaVu Sans (from the DejaVu 2.37 set redistributed by matplotlib)
    DejaVuSans.ttf

  Licence: Bitstream Vera Fonts Copyright / DejaVu changes public domain
           -> LICENSE-DejaVu-BitstreamVera.txt (verbatim)
  Copyright: (c) 2003 Bitstream, Inc.; DejaVu changes are public domain;
             glyphs imported from Arev are (c) Tavmjong Bah.

  The Bitstream Vera licence grants redistribution and sale as part of
  a larger software package, with the copyright and permission notice
  included, and forbids selling the font by itself. Both hold here.
  NOTE: this is NOT the SIL OFL. It is a separate permissive licence
  and is kept in its own file for that reason.

--------------------------------------------------------------------
Adding a font here: keep the .ttf UNMODIFIED, copy its licence file
verbatim next to it, and add a block above naming the version, the
source and the licence. Do not point Font_BRepFont at a family name.
